task: Extend the ABI-v10 open-summary codec to preserve typed operator requirements.
observation: The codec roundtrip and nonweakening tests can be extended at the wire-record layer without changing checker adapters. Adding the summary record version to the semantic/private record dispatch was also necessary so version 2 summaries reach the strict decoder while old version 1 summaries fail there.
impact: The focused codec tests now verify exact typed fields, tamper rejection, ordinal bounds, and imported requirement preservation independently of checker wiring.

resolution.summary: Version 2 carries argument TypeExprs, optional result TypeExpr, and ordered argument access modes; the checker remains unconnected.

task: Restore source-free ABI-v10 imports after summary wire version 2 became authoritative.
observation: The H3 direct checked-body verifier still selected summaries only when the payload version byte was 1, and its legacy-poison helper treated any non-version-1 semantic payload as text. With version-2 summaries, the verifier missed the summary and the poison helper corrupted opaque summary bytes. Updating both helpers to recognize validated version-2 records fixed the focused fixture.
impact: The codec version bump required updates at both compiler dispatch sites and test helpers that classify typed records; otherwise the direct source-free fixture gave misleading failures unrelated to checked-body content.

resolution.summary: Version-2 summaries now dispatch through the strict summary validator and fixture helpers exclude typed summaries from textual legacy processing.
